3061065921.detail_text: About this project 【360° Rotatable, Height adjustable 】 This bookshelf allows 360 degree rotation at the bottom, while also providing adjustable Angle and height to meet your needs. Effectively reduce the pressure caused by poor reading posture on the neck, shoulders and waist. 【High-quality bookshelf】 The bookshelf bracket and base are made of high-quality lightweight aluminum alloy materials, and the bookboard is made of high-quality acrylic materials. Ensure long-term protection against rust and corrosion. In addition, the base of the bookshelf has a non-slip silicone mat that can be securely attached to the desktop. 【Wider board and 2 bendable clips】 Made of high-quality acrylic and hardware, this bookshelf is capable of holding books or tablets of all sizes. The durability and flexibility of the folder ensure easy page turning. This bookshelf is suitable for a variety of occasions, including the kitchen, office, living room and any other place where it is needed. It can be used to hold Bibles, recipes, laptops, textbooks, documents, and sheet music. It caters to people of all ages who have a passion for reading. 【Convenient installation and storage】 The bookshelf is designed in a folding style, which can easily adjust multiple angles and heights to meet your special needs. Once you're done reading, you can easily fold the reading rack to save space or keep it unrolled as a versatile laptop stand or phone stand.

Versatile Mobile Stand

This product is a versatile mobile stand, perfect for live broadcasts, watching movies, and taking photos.

Easy Installation

With its user-friendly design, this stand can be easily installed, making it suitable for both beginners and professionals.

Rotatable Base

The rotatable base allows for smooth and effortless rotation, providing you with the flexibility to view your content from any angle.

Adjustable Height

Featuring an adjustable height design, it allows you to find the perfect viewing angle for your device.

Portable Design

Its portable design makes it easy to carry around, ensuring you can enjoy your content anytime, anywhere.

3609215726.detail_html:
Feature:

【360° Rotatable & Adjustable】: Designed with a 360° rotatable axis, this laptop stand allows you to easily share your screen with someone sitting across the room.You can adjust the angles and heights according to your needs. This perfect design will increase your work efficiency when collaborating with others

【Ergonomic Design】: Featuring adjustable angles and heights, this computer stand can raise your laptop to your eye level to fix your posture and reduce your neck and back stiffness.Just push or pull the laptop riser when you want to go up or down. No tools required

【Foldable & Portable】: This fully foldable laptop holder weighs 750 grams and can be fully folded into a small size of 11.4 inches * 1.7 inches. You can put it in your sleeve bag and carry it anywhere. Ideal for people who travel a lot for business

【Broad Compatibility】: The laptop stand for desk is well compatible with all laptops from 10 to 17-inch and other devices

【Heat Dissipation】: This laptop stand provides good ventilation and airflow to prevent your laptop from overheating. It is made of 100% aluminium alloy, which can help dissipate heat to cool down your laptop

【Warm Reminder】: To ensure the safety of your device, please remove your laptop or tablet from the stand before adjusting the height or angle




Notice:


1. Do not overstretch the bracket to avoid damaging the bracket turntable.

2. When opening the stand, pull up (do not turn the stand).

3.The bracket has three load-bearing axes, and the middle axis is the support point, so you need to pay attention to the angle: too small will cause sagging (it is recommended that the angle not be less than 110 degrees)

4. The horizontal phase difference range is within 1cm, which is a normal value and will not affect use.

5. The expansion part of the left lever on the bracket and the baffle on the lower right lever are relatively more flexible, which is a feature of the design, not a problem with the bracket. If you mind this, please buy it with caution.

product.desc:
Versatile Compatibility



This cooling fan is compatible with various Apple tablets including iPadPro mini7/6/Air5/4/3, making it a versatile choice for Apple users.






Ergonomic Stand



The ergonomic stand design not only enhances the cooling efficiency but also provides a comfortable viewing angle, perfect for gaming or video watching.






Semiconductor Cooling Technology



Utilizing advanced semiconductor cooling technology, this iPadPro cooling fan ensures efficient heat dissipation, keeping your device cool during intense use.






Magnetic Absorption Design



The magnetic absorption design allows for easy attachment and detachment, providing a secure hold on your iPadPro while in use.






Durable Material



Crafted from durable materials, this cooling fan is built to last, offering long-term use and reliability.

3479931754.title: 360° Rotating Adjustable Book Stand Tablet Stand Book Holder Elastic Page Clips Foldable Desktop Riser
3479931754.detail_text: 【Ergonomic Book Stand for Reading】 The book reading stand can be adjusted at multiple angles and heights, you can adjust the book or computer to fit your position that you can study and work in the correct posture to improve learning and work efficiency, and it also could improve spinal health and eliminate fatigue and soreness in the eyes, neck, back, and shoulders. 【360°Rotating Base】 Our book stand comes with a 360° rotatable base and the panel can be adjusted 180°, the non-slip support design allows you to communicate without leaving your work position, perfect for discussing assignments, sharing reading, project content, and for video conferencing. 【Foldable Design, Installation Free】 The foldable design makes it easy to put in a drawer or display books and pictures. For the convenience of customers, our acrylic book stand without installation, which can largely save your time without worrying about the lack of accessories that make it unusable.Lightweight design can be taken everywhere for reading and working. 【Wide Board With 2 Adjustable Retaining Clip】 Our laptop stand is made of premium heavy duty alminium alloy frame. The book holder features 2 flexible adjustable and strong clips to keep your laptop or book sit on the tray stable. Allows for holding the laptop or easy turning pages while the rubber tips prevent damage. 【Multifunctional, Best Gift】 Multi-functional cookbook holder suitable different sizes and styles of books, tablets, magazines, drawings, sheet music, fingerings, laptops. Perfect for family, friends, colleagues, especially those who love to cook, craft, read or watch videos. 【Durable and Simple Design】 The reading stand made of transparent acrylic, simple design provides more enjoyable reading. Struts and base made of high-quality lightweight aluminum alloy. Anodied coating offers long-lasting protection against rust & corrosion. suitable for study, classroom, library, music room, kitchen, office, etc. 【Tips】 The metal arms take some effort to move up and down, but that's a good thing.
